items.prompt: A closed black horse carriage with shuttered windows, seen from behind, rolls away down a narrow North Calcutta lane at deep night, one horse mid-stride. Bengal, 1880s: two- and three-storey lime-plastered houses with flat roofs and parapets, arched ground-floor doorways, wooden balconies with cast-iron railings, closed louvred wooden shutters in muted ochre and brown, a kerosene lamp on a wall bracket, an earthen drain channel. A flat low horizon, one full moon, wide indigo sky. Indigo night, silver moonlight, lamp amber.

Hemshashi's mother, a 40-year-old Bengali woman, kind careworn round face, red bindi, small gold earrings, an ivory-white cotton sari with a thin red border draped over her head, red blouse. Full soft cheeks, large round dark eyes open, looking down at her hands. Medium wide, morning: she sits cross-legged on a straw mat at the right of a plain cream-walled room, folding green betel leaves on a brass tray; the mat beside her lies empty. Bengal, 1880s. Ivory, faded vermilion, pale gold.
